evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies `src/rpc/net.cpp` parameter validation for the `setban` RPC method.
rationale: Prevents signed integer overflow and silent ban drops when callers provide relative ban times near INT64_MAX. As noted in the description, 'GetTime() + bantime... wraps negative, causing the node to treat the ban as already expired and silently drop it while setban still returns success.'
